module.name: scmvx
module.description: Map view showing maps with stations and events. Issues related to configuration of stations are indicated.

parameter.name: displaymode
parameter.description: Set one of the available display modes used during startup for defining which tab is shown. When empty, the Network tab is shown.

parameter.name: readEventsNotOlderThan
parameter.description: Sets the time span before current time to read events initially from database.

parameter.name: centerOrigins
parameter.description: If a new origin/event is set/selected, this option defines if the map is centered or not at the origin location.

parameter.name: annotations
parameter.description: Enables/disabled drawing of station annotations at startup.

parameter.name: annotationsWithChannels
parameter.description: Show full stream codes with station annotations including location and channel codes as NET.STA.LOC.CHA.

parameter.name: showUnboundStations
parameter.description: Enable/disable drawing of stations which are not bound with global bindings.

parameter.name: mapLegendPosition
parameter.description: The legend location for station symbols (network, QC, ground motion).

parameter.name: eventLegendPosition
parameter.description: The legend location for event symbols.

parameter.name: statusLegendPosition
parameter.description: The location of the network status legend summarizing station configuration issues, data delays and latencies of the visible stations. Legends at the same location are stacked and can be switched by the arrows in their header.

group.name: display
group.description: The initial rectangular region for the map. The eventual region is also scaled to the dimension of the opened map widget.

parameter.name: latmin
parameter.description: Minimum latitude in degrees.

parameter.name: lonmin
parameter.description: Minimum longitude in degrees.

parameter.name: latmax
parameter.description: Maximum latitude in degrees.

parameter.name: lonmax
parameter.description: Maximum longitude in degrees.

group.name: events
group.description: The initial configuration for events. The visibiliy of events can be set by configuration of the global parameter "map.layers.events.visible".

parameter.name: showLatestEventWidget
parameter.description: Show the latest event widget. The widget can be toggelt interactively by the View menu.

group.name: recentList
group.description: Legend listing the most recent events. Clicking an event centers the map on it, double clicking opens its details.

parameter.name: count
parameter.description: Number of events to list. Set to 0 to disable the list.

parameter.name: position
parameter.description: The legend location. Legends at the same location are stacked and can be switched by the arrows in their header.

parameter.name: amplitudeTimeSpan
parameter.description: Time span for forming the maximum value as envelope to the traces in the trace window for a station.

parameter.name: groundMotionRecordLifeSpan
parameter.description: Time to keep waveform data in memory.

parameter.name: triggerTimeout
parameter.description: Time span to show phase picks of a station by a blinking triangle.

parameter.name: triggerFrameSize
parameter.description: The size of the frame of a station symbol if in trigger mode.

parameter.name: groundMotionFilter
parameter.description: Sets the filter applied to determine ground motion.

parameter.name: networkColors
parameter.description: Fixed colors of station symbols per network in the Network tab as list of NET:color, e.g. "AU:#1f77b4, S1:orange". Colors are given as hex codes or SVG color names. All other networks are assigned automatically with colors which are perceptually as distinct as possible from each other and from the configured colors.

option.description: Load events in given XML file during startup and switch to offline mode.
Do not connect to a messaging server and do not subscribe channel data.
